steps.name: After taking a break...
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Helena] in “Lulia Village.”

steps.name: Helena and Kaina
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Helena] in 「Lulia Village」, go to the left of [Helena].
2. After the conversation, enter the “Oracle Room” at “Eidos Gate” and report the quest to [Iris].

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: %s, are you resting well?
(Helena pours tea into the empty cup in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Listen. It is effective against fatigue.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Helena. But there is one more glass.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You said Your Majesty's story would be relayed when the time came, right? I think that's today.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Before that, please explain the ruins you see in the sky.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I won't ask you to tell me everything. Just enough for this person to understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Helena about twilight, God, and the garden, excluding the witch.)
(Helena, listening to %s's story, nods her head repeatedly as if she understands.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: This world is truly full of unknown things. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Hey, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please speak, Helena.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Does this affect your Majesty?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To be honest, I don't know about that. It doesn't seem like there will be any problems right now... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I see… .
(Helena quietly lifts the teacup and takes a sip of the tea inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, why is the Atlas Garden visible only to Helena?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Let me tell you a story that is not exact... . Children who received Sylvaria's blood had special abilities, as if they were blessed.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: His memorization skills are extremely good, he has the talent of a wizard, he can communicate with spirits... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Call it an ability, but sometimes this person would discover new artifacts when he felt a sense of déjà vu.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: The remains of a place where gods stayed in ancient times must have mysterious powers... . There must have been some influence from touching such relics for a long time.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Anyway, after listening to %s's explanation, I think I understand what only my eyes can see. If you think of those as ruins and relics... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I heard those words sometime ago...)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Now I must convey His Majesty's message... .
(As soon as Helena fills another empty cup with tea, someone comes up to them.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Grandma, Kaina is here. It’s been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty?
(Kaina approaches Helena's arms and hugs her tightly. Helena says it's annoying and tries to pull her away, but the niece hardly backs down.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: It's breathtaking, Your Majesty. Really, cluck, cluck. Are you okay with not seeing this person anymore?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What kind of joke are you making like that? Grandma.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I'm sorry this is a boring game. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Your Majesty, Aaron… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Grandma, don’t worry about that.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: If His Majesty says so... . all right.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Then, I will leave the room for a moment so you two can talk.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No, grandma. %s, could you wait behind Grandma’s house for a moment? I'll be there soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty. I'll go first.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you.
(Kaina opens the door and looks at %s's back.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Your Majesty. No, Kaina… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Grandma. Please speak.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: It's a different atmosphere than usual. Seeing that you, who usually send letters, came all the way here in person... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Something important happened... .
(Helena approaches and comforts Kaina in her arms.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Got it… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's been a while since I've seen you, but I have to go back right now... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I can't help it. Next time, I will go as I have nothing to do. and… .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Don't try to endure everything alone... .
(The red-haired knight who was watching the quietly flowing river turns his back as if he senses that he is being watched.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: You are %s. Long time no see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Argent… . hello.
(Argent quietly moves his gaze to Helena's house.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: His Majesty asked me to wait here for a moment to see if he had anything to share with Helena.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Okay. Then you can stay here until your Majesty comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been, Argent?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Nothing major happened. By any chance, do you know? Not Narsha, but a boy who handles a large magic golem... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Noname and Lyricaria... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I heard that you went to a place called Orcarium with a child named Narsha, so I guess you met there.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm looking for that boy, but his whereabouts are unknown after meeting %s. Where on earth did it go... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: If you see that boy in the future, please let me know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Your Majesty will be coming soon.
(Argent hurriedly runs to the front of Helena's house. Then, he escorts Kaina out of the house and returns to where she was.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, Argent. I'm sorry, but please step aside for a moment. I have a story to tell %s.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.
(As requested by Kaina, Argent steps back far enough to not be heard.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You've waited a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Your Majesty. But what you want to say is… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Aaron probably said he was looking for a witch. It seems like he wants something from the witch.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: A witch gains power when she kills another witch, and Aaron wants that power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is Aaron trying to do?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Power would be enough, but if you want something more than that, you need the power of a witch.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: At first, I thought it might be my place, but that wasn't the case. I think I want more than that.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Ordinary people, normal humans, cannot use a witch's abilities. Still, there is a way.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You will have to cooperate with a witch with special abilities or meet a being with the power to make a witch's abilities usable by humans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a moment, Your Majesty. So, does that mean that Aaron is going to meet the witch?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes, it's almost time for Aaron to meet the witch.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Sorry, %s. Every moment I say this, I feel like it's a big burden on %s... .
(Kayna looks at the Isar River flowing behind the village with sad eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Your Majesty... . If we pursue the information you just provided, it will also be helpful to Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I still don't know who His Majesty is...)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Originally, I was going to send you a message by letter like before, but for some reason, I couldn't reach %s.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: So when he came back from the Orcarium, I came to tell him in person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason. What’s going on…?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You don't need to worry too much... . Then I will tell you the time and place.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: First, meet the goddess and then go to the Orcarium. Then, one day, Aaron will appear at the place where you met Noname.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Just check who Aaron meets and what he talks about and then come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that all you need to do?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (His Majesty's expression seems to have hardened...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, do you know what will happen next?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Aaron is not an ordinary person. So you must never get caught. Because nothing else can happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something else…?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, if you say it's something else... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That’s… .
(Kaina opens her mouth as if to say something, but then closes it.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry. I have to go back now... . Please let Dana know as soon as you confirm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you… . See you later then.
(Kaina steps back with a lonely smile for some reason. Then Argent, who was waiting, approaches Kaina.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: … Would you like to return, Your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes… .
(With Kaina's answer, Argent nods and greets %s, who made eye contact. He then points in a direction other than the Laran Road.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This way, Your Majesty.
(Just like that, Kaina and Argent disappear and Helena approaches %s who was looking at their backs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Helena... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: %s, did you have a good chat?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, for now. Because it hasn't happened yet... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: There's no need to worry about things that haven't happened yet... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I'm still anxious. All you have to do is go and experience it first.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Yes, %s… . Are you leaving now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: This person will pray that nothing bad happens.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Helena… . Then I'll go now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I told Iris to go, so let's go to the oracle's room. But what happens if something else happens?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…don’t worry. It will work out somehow….)

steps.name: something that shouldn't happen
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Iris] in the 「Oracle Room」, go to 「Orcarium Secluded Place」.
2. After checking what is happening in “Orcarium Secluded Place,” report the quest to [Arke] in “Pneuma.”

lines.text: (As soon as Adventurer enters the oracle room, Iris welcomes him with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Welcome, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. %s Thanks to you, Levy returned to Gendia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But… , Pandora… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It was something that could not be helped. Pandora will be glad that Levy has returned.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Everything will be okay... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, okay. By the way, Iris. I have one question.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know how His Majesty, the Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire, acquired the ability to foresee?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Although I received the power of Ceres, I do not know the past or actions of those who had the power before receiving the power.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That doesn't mean I know everything that happened afterward. What I know is only a small part of everything that happens in the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You came to meet His Majesty, right? What did you say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Iris the story you heard when you met Kaina.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: After meeting me, you asked me to go to the Orcarium?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a bit of a stretch to say that something else shouldn't happen... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That might be... , it’s just a guess, but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The emperor of the Sylvaria Empire is influenced by time and space. I don't know why he, a human being, is like that.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Don't worry, just go to the Orcarium. Even if something unscheduled happens, don't forget that I am behind %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will protect you with the power of Ceres, who is the owner of me, the moon, flowers, and plants.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And I should have said this first... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? why?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hilda has left.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When? Until I went to Luria Village... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Pandora left as soon as she found out she had been tricked by Daphne.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hilda saw many people killed and injured just because she was a witch. And because I couldn't bear it, I chose to hide for a long time.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then, I met you, my Adventurer, and little by little my strength weakened.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I didn't want Hilda to leave, but she did, saying it was her destiny to run away forever.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What Kazno and Jeryl are trying to do could have unexpected consequences for everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Unexpected result?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm not sure about that. First of all, we'll talk about Hilda later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Iris. I'll come back. See you later.
(Iris waves to %s who is leaving. %s also slowly leaves the oracle room while looking at Iris like that.)
(As Iris is taking steps, a sharp wind blows from somewhere. And through the wind, an alien voice that seems not to exist in this world flows out.)
Iris… .
(A startled Iris tries to catch the approaching wind, but the wind circles around, ignoring Iris.)
You can go back. If you have the desire to go back, I... … … … .
(The voice that was flowing through the wind disperses, making a strange crying sound that does not exist in the world, the moment the wind is caught by Iris's small hand.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The being created by my choice is now trying to test me... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We have to hurry... .
(Adventurer's steps stop in a corner of the Orcarium where I once met Noname.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while since I met Noname, but why does it feel like it's been so long... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's strange that Aaron is coming to the Orcarium, but if His Majesty predicts, it will be soon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let’s hide and wait.
(Adventurer goes into a dark bush blooming in a quiet place and hides.)
(Time passes, but there is no sign of Aaron appearing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When is it coming?)
(The moment Adventurer couldn't overcome boredom and was about to get up, someone's voice was heard from far away.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: We're all here. Come here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh no, I almost got caught. I need to hide properly. Is that person Aaron?)
(%s sees two people walking in here. One is Aaron, and the other is a woman, wearing clothes that are not appropriate for the continent of Prayos.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Gendia, who has come a long way from the Gendia Empire on the Gendia continent... . First of all, I would like to thank you for following me here.
Please just call me JN.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who is that person? Wait… Mr. Gendia?)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: It's okay.
(The woman frowns and looks at Aaron.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: You can call it whatever you want. I won't be seeing Aaron for a long time anyway.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Aaron Ball.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Yes, Jian. You tell me.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I know that the Sun of the Continent of Freios, the Sylvaria Empire, is putting a lot of effort into exchanges with the Kingdom of Elias on the Continent of Gendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: However, I was a bit surprised that they wanted to interact with us, even though we are only in the periphery. There were already things I was sorry about... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: The case of the fake Agashura siblings was also related to the empire. You don't have to worry too much.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I didn't know they would go all the way to Eastland.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Phew… … .
(Zien sighs and looks at Aaron.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Now, Lord Aaron. I know that the person who invited me to the empire was not His Majesty the Emperor of Sylvaria. You are right at the heart of Congress... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is Aaron planning?)
(Aaron smiles with satisfaction.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I think I've seen a mean laugh similar to yours somewhere, but I can't remember.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Hehehe. Don't remember?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I guess it wasn't something memorable. Anyway, please tell me where my missing subject is.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: That's the purpose of what I followed all the way here.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: The inspector was taken by a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Aaron knows everything. But how long do I have to listen? The atmosphere is strange...)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Did you make me come all this way just to say that? That's a fact I also know... .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: As for you being in league with a witch... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: It's great that a foreign monarch finds such information.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Because he had a competent inspector as his subordinate. If you tell me properly, it will also appear on Lord Aaron’s statue… . Now, wait… .
(JN looks at Aaron and steps back as if he felt something.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Jian… .

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I'm sure that's what I felt when I was caught... .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Could you please tell me what my status is?
(Aaron takes out a hideous-looking dagger from his pocket.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Well, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You know this stuff. This is what he uses to take your time… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then… who are you talking about?)
(Aaron fiddles with the dagger and cuts the tip of his finger. Then, blood slowly drips from the wound onto the floor.)
(A red glowing magic circle is created under Zien's feet, and Aaron's fallen blood begins to boil within it.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Clearly, Jien is a being similar to a Demigod... . So you probably thought you could deal with me. However, what you are overlooking is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No matter how much we have to follow the foresight, if things continue like this, Gendia will die. We must save him!!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gndia!! Let's talk later and avoid here!!
(I couldn't just ignore what happened, so the moment Adventurer moved, everything I could see stopped.)
(Zien is terrified, and Aaron is frozen with his sword in hand. A world where everything is literally at a standstill.)
(Adventurer stretches out his arm and tries to grab Giendia, but Adventurer's hand passes through Giendia's stationary body.)
(Not only that, %s's arm that touched Gndia also does not move as if it is frozen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this? ah… . No way, something else is happening... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As if time had stopped... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, what should I do?
(Someone slowly approaches %s, who was so embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, don't move.
(Arke reaches out and grabs %s's left arm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, how did you get here? Wasn't it impossible to get out of pneuma?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think you can go to a place similar to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … This must not be Pneuma... . therefore… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer. Calm down and listen carefully.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Kairos did not wake up, and the hour and minute hands of Chronos stopped working. And based on Adventurer, time and space were divided into two... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche? What does that mean?!

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Come to your senses!!

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm sorry. I don't have time.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: First close your eyes. I will take you to Pneuma, so please do not float until I tell you to.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If you open your eyes, you'll lose your grip. If you let go, even the chance to turn everything back will disappear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I just closed my eyes as Arche said, but my right arm moved again...)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm going, %s. For the time being, Adventurer's frontal time is... .
(Arke's voice gradually becomes fainter and can no longer be heard. As if time has stopped and even the sound has disappeared...)

steps.name: Standards on the front and back
steps.objective: After talking to [Arke] in 「Pneuma」, report the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You can open your eyes now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, why is pneuma like this?
(When Pneuma opened his eyes, he saw a world full of spirits, but it looked different from usual.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Can you see it?
(The spirits that would normally move vigorously are moving slowly. Some Aeruras are frozen in mid-air.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A shadow came from somewhere and covered Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way, in Elysia… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No. I didn't do anything in Elysia. If Pneuma becomes dangerous, Elysia will never be safe.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now, neither Hecate nor Iris can touch this situation. Outside of Pneuma, everyone is at a standstill, just like before we brought Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: According to Iris, an unknown force was involved in the Great Wall, and it even affected Pneuma in the form of a shadow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go to Iris.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer, calm down. The moment Adventurer leaves Pneuma, all time becomes a mess. Even the time Iris and Adventurer spend together... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As if trying to erase the world's time and create new time... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can feel in that shadow the creative will that God had when he created the world in the beginning, which Gaia once told me about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trying to return it to nothing... .  no way… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer, did you listen to me before you came here? Based on Adventurer, space and time were divided into two.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: To be precise, the other side of space and time was created... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This is Adventurer that I brought here. In the Orcarium, there is Adventurer at the front of space and time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute… . I became two?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Think of it like a mirror. However, it is a little different from a mirror. In the mirror, the reflection and the standing self move at the same time... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If Adventurer on the front moves, Adventurer on the back cannot move. Conversely, if Adventurer on the current back side moves, the front side does not move.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's like you can't see both sides of a coin at once... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Still, you will be able to remember what happens on both sides because they are not two different beings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Like I existed in another time, another future?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can't say it's exact, but it'll be similar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how does Arche know that?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: For personal reasons, I went through the process of falling asleep and waking up several times and came to know it naturally while living in Pneuma, where the times of many lives intersect.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer, Adventurer needs to find a way. Adventurer and Iris can make their time together again... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm sorry. This is the only part I can help with... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. Arche… . This is all me... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Irfan will be at the location where the ordeal took place. He will open the door to the place where the will to create was born.
(Arke smiles brightly and holds %s's hands tightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Arche. I will definitely resolve it and come back.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll wait, Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Arke, see you later.
(Arke sees off Adventurer heading to the door to Elysia.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer will be able to come back... .

steps.name: A world divided in half
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Irfan] in 「Elysia」, and go to the 「Vigrid」 portal.
2. Talk to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid 1」, and defeat [Dazzling Illusion of Sinmara] in 「Vigrid」.
3. If you have satisfied all quest conditions, report the quest to [Ellie] in “Bigrid 4.”

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: See you again, %s.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You must have heard the story from Pneuma's manager, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: This is not what Hecate meant... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In the current situation, that means... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Don't interrupt me and listen to the end.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The reason I opened the door to the other side of Etoire was not for you. This is for Elysia.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The wrong will is trying to reach Pneuma, the world of God... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Iris What was created when you passed into the realm of God, whether voluntarily or not, has now grown to this extent.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I'm not blaming Iris, I'm just saying that Iris is in a situation where he can't step forward hastily... . Understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You have no choice but to go and solve it. If you are Iris, you will be able to meet the wrong will and solve this situation.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I wouldn't want Etoire to be swallowed up by wrong will and become something else... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It's up to you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. But, where should I go?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You'll find out as you descend beneath the trials of the Black Moon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Mr. Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hurry up and go.
(Irrfan looks at the back of Adventurer going down to the ordeal of the earth.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: A real snake, not a shadow, appears... .
(The moment you step into the place Irrfan showed you, the gray landscape of Elysia begins to distort.)
(As we move forward, step by step, the distorted landscape gradually disappears, as if submerged in the approaching darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all dark, like the road to Pneuma. Uh, the light from over there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There must be a way out on the side where the light is visible, right? Let's go there first... What is this nostalgic feeling...?)
(As the darkness disappears, a new place appears in front of %s, who was walking along the light. A desolation that cannot be felt anywhere else approaches, naturally making him stop his steps.)
(In a place that appears to be a village, buildings that show what happened have been destroyed or only partially remain in an ugly state.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's going on here? Let's check it out first.)
(The moment he moves forward to explore a new place, the cold, sharp feeling of metal approaches the back of Adventurer's neck.)
Just go straight to the wall and stick to it. hurry… .
(The low voice of a woman who appears to be the sword's owner is heard.)
Do as you are told. Just answer what is asked. If you understand, nod your head.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now, let’s do as we are told, see the situation, and get out of the way.)
(Adventurer nods and the sword moves back slightly.)
Hurry up and tell me who you are and where you come from.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am %s… .
Who? %s?
(Ask if the woman was surprised to hear the name %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I am %s… , I came here to solve the situation I was in from a place called Etoire.
Etoire? Gendia continent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know the continent of Gendia?
I'll raise my sword, so turn around and look at me, %s… .
(Adventurer, feeling the woman's voice becoming softer, carefully turns his back.)
(Elias Makes eye contact with a woman dressed in what appears to be traditional clothing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … you are?
(A smile slowly appears on the face of the woman who had a stern expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this sense of déjà vu...? I'm sure this is my first time seeing this person, but it doesn't feel unfamiliar...)
(Tears begin to form around the woman's eyes little by little. %s is also embarrassed by the sight of the woman suddenly crying.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay? Why are you doing this?
(Tears suddenly flow from the eyes of %s, who was looking at the crying woman.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why am I crying?
Don't cry, %s.
(A woman approaches him and wipes his tears. Adventurer steps back in surprise, but the woman extends a reassuring hand.)
I understand. It's definitely going to be weird. Because you get a familiar feeling from someone you see for the first time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How... . Are you a god too?
I am not god. Just an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You say it's not God, but you're saying it as if you read my thoughts. Have we seen this before?
Right… . you have seen me You remembered. I thought I would never remember... .
Some of you must have known me originally. Some of you will remember me as someone I met by chance.
The person in front of me right now may not be the person in my memories... . Still, you came here of your own will. I met the person I am now.
And I want you to remember. Please don't forget. My name is Ellie... .
(The moment the woman reveals her name, %s's mind suddenly begins to shake. And through that gap, many memories flow in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Luminous... ?
(The moment you say the name Luminous, the surroundings suddenly become dark.)
(Ellie quickly grabs %s's hands. Then the darkness that filled %s's vision disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There is no need to force yourself to remember. Because you are a wonderful and sufficient being just the way you are... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seeing that person makes me feel calm. Why is he like that….)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There is nothing for you to do here in [Bigrid] right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Big grid… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll make a way for you, so go back to where you came from.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't go back.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: What's going on in Etoire?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .
(The moment Adventurer is about to explain the situation to Ellie, the ground suddenly shakes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it?
(As the ground shakes, beings from another world that had not been seen before appear and approach the two people.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Where does it keep appearing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do, Ellie?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Now it seems to me that you have no intention of going back... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Since I can't help it, I won't call you out and tell you to go back.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Now, follow me. %s… .

steps.name: Vigrid behind the scenes
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Ellie] in 「Bigrid 4」, defeat [Indignant Gulincambi] and [Hungry Heidrun] in 「Bigrid」.
2. Report the quest to [Ellie] in “Bigrid 4.”

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Let's rest here for now. It's only for a moment, but here you can take a breather.
(Ellie defeats the being from another world chasing her and looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, you said this is Bigrid, right?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: If you want to hear from me, tell me your story first. Because I haven't heard an answer from you yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason I came here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Ellie briefly why you came to Bigrid.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The place you can go to in the world that has become the other side is, of course, the other side.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then here too… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: This is Bigrid. This is the other side of a place called Luminous City.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Luminous City was created with one person's wish to be free from painful, painful, and sad emotions.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: A long time ago, it was called Yggdrasil. This is the place Iris dreamed of when he fell asleep before becoming a star god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. Yggdrasil used to be nothing but trees and has now become like this?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It'll be complicated to understand. Odin and Nii met you a long time ago in the distant past. But for you, that happened just a few years ago... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin, together with Nii, created a village full of the emotions that Iris dreams of on Yggdrasil.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: At first, it was a village with no one, but people from other worlds immigrated and settled there, and children were born, and the streets became full of life.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I was trying to talk... , I guess not now.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The number of beings from other worlds has increased since then.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But where did it come from? The door wasn't found... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Anyway, I think I need to fix it one more time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will help too.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thank you. But should we come back and finish the story?

steps.name: the person who waited for you
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Ellie] in 「Bigrid 4」, defeat [Veteran Ganglati] in 「Bigrid」.
2. Talk to someone in “Bigrid 6”, then return to “Bigrid 4” and report the quest to [Ellie].

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Good job.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Then, please repeat the interrupted story.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Okay. But how far did I go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The village was full of life with people from other worlds and new born children.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll talk next... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The sight of a village full of people felt like a bright light, so Nii gave it the name Luminous.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin and Nii did not want to see the end of Yggdrasil. I hoped it would last forever.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: However, the weak points of an imperfect and unstable world are always revealed.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Luminous is like that, Etoire is like that. Those who wish for a fate of destruction continue to threaten... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Just like when the gate to the demon world was connected to Etoire, something like that happened here once. It wasn't just once or twice... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: We had to do what we could. I moved to find a way to protect all life living in my beloved village.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Cut the world in half without people noticing. We created a space that is different from Luminous. We're all in the same Yggdrasil anyway... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: And the roots of the world tree were brought and planted in that area.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Same as Luminous, but in a different location. The other side was created. So that external threats can only come from behind... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Even if those who want to come here from other worlds come in, they cannot escape this place, which is the other side of Luminous.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That's how this place became [Bigrid], a battlefield fighting against external invasions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Battlefield… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So there are no people and the buildings are broken... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Those who wish for the destruction of the world continue to try to connect various worlds. The more it happens, the more the great wall shakes... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That was the reason why Luminous, who had maintained a certain distance, gradually got closer to Etoire.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I heard from Odin that the demigod blew up this place with his own power. That doesn't make sense.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: If it had been that simple, everyone wouldn't have suffered... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I don't want to lose this place where my precious people are... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Follow me, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are we going?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There's someone who wants to see you... .
(The two arrive at a new location through the yard of a small house that seems to have been a people's home.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Everyone is here. Here… .
(A tree with glowing blue leaves is visible behind the remains of a destroyed gray building.)
(Green leaves sway in the blowing wind as if welcoming the arrival of %s.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: This tree is Lerad.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Don’t you feel the energy of the World Tree?
(Eli approaches the blue tree, Lerad, and strokes its trunk.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thank you for holding on today too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? I feel safe here.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That’s… .
Ellie, may I speak for you?
(A woman with long shiny hair slowly walks out from behind Lerard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… Nii?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It’s been a while, %s… .
(Nii approaches Adventurer and gently hugs her with both arms.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: To meet you again like this, crossing so much time, shaky space, and unreachable dimensions... . I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: For some it may be a short time, for others it may be a long time, but we met again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nii says the same thing as Ellie.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Hehe, really? I can't help it. I can say that because you are more special than anyone else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm a little embarrassed because you keep doing that... .
(Nii laughs softly and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Hehe, I'll leave my greetings to you. %s, look at LATALE.
(The tree, slightly taller than a person, is firmly standing in place with a strong feel.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Lerrad is not very big, but it stretches powerfully toward the sky. It stands at the center of Bigrid and plays the role of supporting Luminous.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: If Lerad breaks down, Luminous will collapse. If worst comes to worst, you and I and the little world we loved could be reduced to rubble.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Then it will scatter into space and fall into Etoire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that what Ouroboros wants?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Half right, half no. Ouroboros just wants everything to disappear, not destruction.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: The current destruction of Vigrid is the result of Ouroboros' will meeting the will of the Absolute.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Ouroboros was supposed to be found as a card, but it roams around in various places at various times.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: He must have left his mark here and there. I think you've probably met me too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Snake shadow….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you know so much?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Did you forget? Because I am the guardian of Luminous City.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It was once a dragon destined to destroy the World Tree... . Thanks to you, I overcame that fate and am here. So me and Odin are always grateful to %s.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: So, feel free to finish what you have to do and go back to your four hours.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Nii. I'd like to say hello to Odin too, where is he?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin went to find a place where there might be a door to another world. When I find it, I'll organize it right away and come to Lerad.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Now it's time to come back... .
(Nii seems to have noticed something and motions for Adventurer and Ellie to step aside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nii?
(Soon, a black mist blooms from beneath Nii's feet and fills the space where Lerad is. After a while, a dragon with shining black scales appears from the gap.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That look….)
(The black dragon shouted something at the approaching external enemies, but the enemies did not stop and continued to approach.)
(In the end, the enemies ignore the warning and are reduced to ashes by the black dragon's breath.)
(Fog rises around the black dragon again. The black fog engulfs the black dragon and slowly disappears, placing Nii back in its place.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'm sorry, Nii. I never thought they would follow us.
(Nii, who has returned to her original form through the fog, slowly approaches.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It's okay, Ellie. They didn't follow Ellie. I was just instinctively drawn here.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Wait… .
(As soon as Nii looks at the sky, everything in Vigrid begins to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … What's happening?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It seems like the door to another world has arrived in Vigrid... . Did it fall in a place where Odin couldn't find it?
(Nii looks around and becomes anxious as if she felt something. Ellie, seeing this, comes over and grabs Nii’s hands.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Nii, it's okay. Don't be anxious.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Thanks, Ellie.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: … I was just a little surprised because I felt not one, but many different energies. I think it's death and fire... . Anyway… .
(Nii has calmed down and looks at Adventurer cautiously.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: %s, I need your help.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Maybe something has happened that you need to do now. Finding the door that connects to Bigrid... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Finding the door….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you mean, Nii.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Thank you, %s… . Please take care of Ellie.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll be back, Nii.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, you know the road we just took, right? Let's go there and take a look at the situation.

steps.name: death station
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Ellie] in 「Bigrid 4」, enter 「Niflheim Station」.
2. Defeat [Hel] at 「Niflheim Station」 and obtain <Hell's Token>. Then return to “Bigrid 4” and report the quest to [Ellie].

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I thought I had defeated all the enemies invading Vigrid... .
(Ellie feels lonely as she looks at the external beings wandering around Vigrid from afar.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, look over there.
(A structure with a different feel from Vigrid has been built in the direction Ellie pointed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the door to another world... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There is thick fog on one side, and lava is flowing on the other side. Until now, two doors have never appeared at the same time... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Usually, when one door disappears, another appears and so on.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Those doors weren't visible until you came. But after you came, it seems like they all appeared at once... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As if he was waiting for me to come... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Plus, something's a little strange.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: The enemies that have appeared so far have tried to gnaw or destroy everything in Vigrid, including Lerad.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But some beings over there don't seem to care about that. I'm checking out what kind of place this is. As if gathering information... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I need to check the door... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, please stop the enemies here so that Lerad is not in danger. I'll go and check.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I feel a little relieved because of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, there's someone over there. That… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: In front of the door where the fog is flowing out? Ah, it's Odin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Odin... .
(As Ellie said, a man with a lonely, wolf-like look is standing nearby, looking at the door.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Leave this to me. And if anything strange happens, come back here.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Okay? You must come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much, Ellie. Then I'll come back.
(A large structure that looks like the entrance to a train station is built inside Bigrid.)
(In front of him, a man with mysterious odd eyes raises his head and looks at the sign attached to the structure.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nippleheim... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .
(Odin turns his head when he hears the voice of %s approaching.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: It was you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .
(The moment he encounters Odin, various images of him appear in %s's mind.)
(From the confident head of the white world to the chairman who was looking at Valhalla Academy with a cool look.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Sorry, %s… . I had to stop you from coming to Vigrid... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I know how you ended up here. A twist in time must have brought you here... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: If I, the god of this world, had been stronger, I would have overcome fate and prevented something like that from happening to you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Odin. Odin is still protecting Vigrid well enough. Don't be too hard on yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because I came here now to do what I have to do... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I didn't doubt why Iris trusted and relied on you, but now I understand. You've become a lot stronger and more solid over the years, %s... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I don't know if this is the way to save your time and Vigrid. Still, I guess I should try it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What method?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The world beyond this door is different from the world I have dealt with so far. So I have to use another method.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: There is someone waiting for us beyond the door. The owner of that world, he also does not want Vigrid to be connected to his world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Any master of the world who knows the existence of Yggdrasil and Lerad naturally knows.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: 「… When all the worlds that are attracted by the power of Yggdrasil gather together, their own war will break out, which will soon become Ragnarok.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ragnarok… ?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Let's go, %s. First, to the world of death [Niflheim]... .
(Odin slowly takes steps to enter the world called Niflheim.)
(The fog of death flowing from within becomes thicker and gradually erases the image of Odin in Vigrid.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nippleheim… . For some reason, it feels unfamiliar. What kind of place is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I have to follow Odin's words and go in... .
(Adventurer Also, following Odin through the fog, a small being who was looking at this place from afar approaches the door.)
Could it be that the gate of Niflheim has also reached here?
I can't do it. … I have to go and tell Surt… .
(The moment they step into the foggy world, a chill that they have never felt before approaches and surrounds the two people.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it's cold.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Niflheim is cold only at first. You'll get used to it soon. however… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Odin, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: This is not the Niflheim I know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are there multiple Niflheim locations?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: There is only one World Tree, but there are countless worlds that know about the World Tree... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Those worlds shouldn't touch each other. The moment it touches it, only the world with the power will survive, and the rest will disappear.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: That's Ragnarok... . Their own war for survival centered around the World Tree... . And the place where such a war takes place is Vigrid... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: These worlds put a lot of effort into maintaining their own worlds. Just like my world tried not to collide with Etoire's.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As expected... .
(As Odin looks around to check his surroundings, a silhouette that appears to be a woman moves through the thick fog inside.)
I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That person... .
(As Adventurer raises his weapon and stands guard, Odin extends his arm to block. After a while, the owner of the silhouette comes out of the fog and appears in front of the two.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: This is Hel, the owner of Niflheim.
(A woman embracing a purple light, which seems to be the only light in a black world, approaches with a clicking sound.)
(Hel, with his arms crossed in a relaxed manner, gazes at Odin and Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: It seems that neither I nor Niflheim are the people and beings you know. After all, you are not Odin who sent me here... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: There Adventurer. I haven't seen you in person. I was in a fantasy where I was catching a space-time bug that had fallen on Niflheim.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: When the other me was caught by a bug... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Anyway, let's end this greeting and tell them the reason for coming here.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: This place must be destroyed. To be exact... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Let's say it again.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Literally. Lord of Niflheim, you don't want Ragnarok to happen either.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Looking forward to a day of joy! It is a place created to welcome guests. Destroy a place like that? Also, uninvited guests... ?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: We can't mess this up. Here… , here!!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As more doors open in Vigrid, Niflheim will collapse in an instant, hell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there no other way?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The owner of Niflheim also knows very well that there is no other way.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: This is my world, Niflheim.
(The moment Hel closes her eyes and opens them, her red eyes begin to glow.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Wait, hell!!
(The moment Hel raises one hand to open the eyepatch, the black fog behind it leaps out and approaches Odin and Adventurer at high speed.)
(The black fog binds the two people and blows them towards the passage they came in from.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I cannot accept your demands as they cannot even stop my power that fills this world... .
(The scattered black fog gathers again, and a being who was thought to have flown away slowly walks out through it.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Why didn't it fly out?
(Hel looks at the person approaching with a surprised expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I had to hold on, but the fog dissipated. Ah, Odin… .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I can't believe you're still here, with only Odin flying away.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I mistook you here for the you in my fantasy. I apologize. The you back then and the you you are now must be very different... .
(Hel is thinking deeply about something and then quietly turns his back.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Then let me hear your story. I need to know why you came here. That way, I too will understand. But not here now.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I'll be waiting for you in front of the road to Niflheim City.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: If your will is strong, you will be able to meet me again, who will be waiting for you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. Hell!
(He stretches out his hand and tries to grab Hel, but Hel evaporates in place, leaving only her words to say.)
(In addition, beings who appear to be residents of Niflheim from afar are approaching at high speed, as if they are coming to catch the intruding outsiders.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, I can't believe I'm trying to confirm my will like this... . I can't help it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Hel. I'll go and tell you the story properly... .
(Every time you move to another area of Niflheim Station, a biting cold wind approaches.)
(After a while, we arrived at the end of Niflheim Station, and the passage to the outside gradually became visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the path Hel was talking about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? The air above is obviously cold, but the bottom is getting warmer... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You feel it too.
(%s, who was bending down and placing his hands on the floor, could see Hell's boots approaching with a clicking sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hell….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Literally. It's getting hotter here. This is probably because the gate to Muspelheim is nearby.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Well, since you came here safely to meet me, tell me your story. I will listen.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Why are you hesitating?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Hel briefly the story of how he came to Vigrid.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: … okay. You have that reason too... .
(Hel listens to %s's story and quietly looks at the river outside Niflheim Station.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: The place where the wounded god was exiled was a place where there was no sense of life, as there was only ice and the cold flowing from the ice.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: There is nothing different about what God has to do. We must take care of life in any place.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: In another world, it didn't matter if this place was called death or the beginning of hell.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Those who come here only come to escape the end of despair.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: So God comforted them who had overcome the cold and together they created Niflheim... . after… .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: But, if it continues to get hot like this... . This world will disappear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hel, the god in the story is you, right?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Yes. This is my story as the owner of this place. I have to decide now. Before even the will that raised me melted away... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: This is a place created for the coming day of joy.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: %s, give me up so I can protect Niflheim. If that's the way to protect you and Vigrid... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?
(Hel smiles lightly as she looks at Adventurer looking at her.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: kill me
(As Hel's smile disappears, Niflheim Station begins to shake. And soon the cold world is filled with the fog of death rising around Hel.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Before I kill you. hurry… .
(Adventurer's strike, with all his might, shakes off the fog of death and flies towards Hel.)
Boom.
(Hel, who had flown far away, gets up again, but falls to the floor as if he has no strength.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Why are you reaching out to me?
(Hel falls to the floor and looks at %s's hand held out towards him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I don't think there's much point in fighting like this.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Kill me, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't do that. For this reason you... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Even in the visions I saw, you didn't kill me. You would have had a chance to kill me... .
(Hel stands up, holding %s's hand. Then he steps back and turns his back.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: If that's the case, there's nothing we can do. If you won't kill me, then I have to kill me too... .
(With Hel's words, the river flowing outside Niflheim Station stops moving. After a while, the water rising from the river covers Hel and freezes her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hell? Hell!!
(The fog of death rising around Hel pushes away the approaching Adventurer. Then, the fog splits and some of it turns into sharp thorns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no way... .
(The fog that turned into an awl rises like a strong wave of the sea and burrows into Hel.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hell!! Hell!!
(The startled Adventurer hurriedly approaches Hel, who is collapsing. Then, all the death fog and cold air surrounding Hel flows down to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this... .
(The warmth I felt from the floor just before disappears, and the cold begins to return.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: That's enough.
(Hel, who had lost her mind, smiles when she wakes up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth have you done?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah, wow, I was surprised, I was surprised. If you suddenly do this... .
(Hel approaches %s and kisses him on the cheek and looks at his reaction.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Why are you so surprised? I guess you're used to this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can't get used to someone you thought was dead waking up.
(Hel smiles brightly as Adventurer is startled and steps back, not knowing what to do.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Thank you, %s… . For breaking the vain will I had... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: While I was in Niflheim for a long time, I waited for that day. Even though I know that day will never come... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because what kind of day is it… .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: The day I met my precious person again, I had decided that it would be a day of joy and I was waiting for it as I pleased.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I knew it was stupid. Maybe it's been a long time and my mind has frozen... . So I think I needed an opportunity.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I guess I should say I'm glad I got rid of it like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But are you okay? really… dead… .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hehe, you were worried about that.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: For me in Niflheim, death is infinite... . It is just a means to gain new enlightenment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I was tricked.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Don't be disappointed, %s. Because you have earned my trust.
(Hel puts something into %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: … Go back and hand this to Odin. And please let me know. I won't let Ragnarok, a vain twilight, occur around the World Tree.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Hel.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You may be the first person to come into the world of the dead and say thank you. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Goodbye, %s.
(As soon as Hel, with the smile on her face, ends her greeting, the cold fog of death rises again.)

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Now, go back and find the gate to Muspelheim to reach Vigrid. And see you later.
(As the fog of death clears, Hel’s figure inside is nowhere to be found.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Muspelheim? Ah, it's late... . Can I go back now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this feeling... .
(A different feeling comes from Niflheim Station, which felt cold just a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's Hell's influence... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, let's go outside and talk to Ellie and Odin. And let’s go to the gate of Muspelheim… .

steps.name: How to Beat the Heat
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ellie] in 「Bigrid 4」, and meet [Nii] in [Bigrid 6].
2. If all conditions are met, click the quest completion button.

lines.text: (Ellie, who was resting for a moment after dealing with an external entity that came to Vigrid, suddenly shakes beneath her feet.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: This shaking... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Don't let down your guard, Ellie.
(Odin appears and grabs the neck of a zombie trying to attack Ellie from behind.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: These are zombies who came out from Niflheim to scout this place. Did you say Ganglati?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The moment they came out to Bigrid, they lost their reason. And the spirit was also eroded by external forces... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Now death is nothing but a monster that longs for life and tries to absorb life force... .
(The blue flame that flows from Odin's hand surrounds the body of the captured zombie. After a while, the flame travels up the zombie's body and turns into ashes.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I'm sorry Hel, but I have no choice but to do it this way... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin, thank you. But didn't you go inside?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Maybe it was because it was a different world, but there was nothing I could do of my own will. Still, I think Adventurer of Iris persuaded Hell and solved the problem... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The shaking that just occurred is evidence that the passage connecting Niflheim and this place is disappearing.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Has Hel changed her mind? .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: That's right, Odin. Then there is only one thing left.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: He's coming over there at the right time.
(Adventurer comes out from the location where the Niflheim Station entrance was and comes to Odin and Ellie.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, Odin. I'm here.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Are you okay, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, no problem.
(Odin, who was next to Ellie, approaches and checks the status of %s.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I can feel the strong energy of Niflheim. If you brought anything, show it to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was something Hel told Odin to give. here… .
(Give Hel’s token to Odin.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Entrusting a part of your life force to me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you willing to share the fate of this place?
(Odin quietly nods his head instead of answering.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Because that's the best in the current situation... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. But, Odin… .  How can we all go away and end this situation in the way everyone wants?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Those who want destruction just don't touch Etoire.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: In the current situation where we cannot stop his will, all we can do is become stronger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In the end, it has to be enough to shake his will... . That's harsh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you just worry, there will be no end to it. Come on, Odin. Let's go to the next location. To the gates of Muspelheim... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Wait, wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The lava that flows out of the door to Muspelheim is not ordinary lava.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Right now it's only a small amount of water flowing out, but if the barrier that blocks it is broken, it will overflow. A huge amount will pour down to the point where it will hit Vigrid... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Ragnarok begins with the fire of Surtur burning Vigrid.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Surtr is the master of Muspelheim and fire... . A being born with the fate of burning everything.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Surt is probably also worried because he doesn't want his fire to burn other areas. However, there is no way to get in from here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .
There is a way.
(A being from another world suddenly approaches Odin and %s, who were worried.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: If you don't want to disappear, stop there.
Anyway, this is welcome. Even if you destroy it, another illusion will come to visit you. So listen to me.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Ellie, I'm sorry. Please step aside.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: You there, I can feel the fire of Muspelheim. Are you… .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Can I say that I am Shinmara, Surtur's family?
(An illusion of Sinmara reveals his name and hovers around Odin, Ellie, and %s.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Odin, you cannot enter Muspelheim.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I know, Sinmara… .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Before the lava can cover Vigrid, the shadow wolf will rush through the great wall and devour me.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin? What's the story?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: The heavenly bride will purify the world and all sin will disappear... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I’ve heard that before somewhere, where have I heard it before? Ah….)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Although we do not want it, the future of the world intertwined with the World Tree is recorded in the Book of Revelation [Eda]. It's a terrible story about the world's owner and the world disappearing in flames.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eda?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I heard there was a girl with a similar name somewhere. Don't worry about that.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: So the Lord of this land must not move carelessly. So send someone to replace you. A person who can withstand the fire of Surtur... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Odin, not that woman. Ordinary humans will turn to ashes as soon as they set foot in Muspelheim.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Eli, I know what you mean, but this is something you can't handle.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I understand. Unfortunately, I can't help it... .
(The illusion of Shinmara approaches %s and makes eye contact.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Is it you? I came back after talking with the owner of Niflheim. Hmm, let’s see. You are not an ordinary human after all.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: A human being who received God's protection in a twisted and distorted time... .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: If I push you into the Muspels Tunnel, you might survive. Still, serious burns cannot be avoided.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll try it. I have to… .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Your thoughts are shorter than you think. It's not that easy. Are you going to make everyone die?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Sinmara, do we just need to find a way to overcome the fire flowing through Muspelheim?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Yes, Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Okay, whoa… .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Eli comes out from each door here and deals with the encroached ones.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Sinmara, %s. follow me
(Odin takes the illusion of Shinmara and Adventurer to the front of Lerrad where Nii is located.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, I'm here.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Oh my, Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As you know, the gates of Niflheim and Muspelheim... .
(Nii does not listen to what Odin is trying to say, but reaches out both hands and grabs his waist.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I am protecting Lerad diligently, but is it okay for me to be away for this long? uh? How long did you wait?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: It took a little long, right? Sorry.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I'm generous, so I'll gladly forgive you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I've seen a scene like this sometime... Ah, why don't I like it?)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Nice to see you two. No gods and dragons.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Where does this cute friend come from? No way, I fell in love with Odin... .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: It's not like that. I'm not into men, so it's okay. You keep it.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Thank you, little lady.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Are you trying to ask me for something?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Because you rarely show that kind of expression. Tell me, Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Yeah... .
(A vision of Odin and Shinmara tells Nii about her current situation and that she needs strength to overcome the fire.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Yeah, okay.
(Nii smiles softly and flips her hair. Then she grabs Odin’s hand and places it on her neck.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Are you okay here? No matter how much it is my request... .

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin, I'm always okay. You are by my side. Think about the things that are important to us.
(Nii smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii… .
(Odin looks at Nii and lowers his head. Then, accepting Nii's wishes, he lifts the hand that was placed on Nii's neck.)
(Nii closes her eyes tightly as if in pain. After a moment, Nii's neck cracks slightly and a black shard that looks like cold, hard metal rises from the crack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Black dragon scales, darker than pitch black... . If you hold that in your hand, even the lava of Muspelheim will feel cool.
(When Odin takes the scale in his hand, Nii, who was struggling to hold on, falls down. Odin, who is startled, hurries to grab Nii and makes her sit in front of Lerad.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, I’m sorry… .

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Don't make that face. See, the wound healed quickly.
(Nii points to his neck with a nonchalant expression.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I didn't want to cause you this pain.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Just by letting me stay by your side while I was a predator of the world tree, you have already become my world. It became my everything... .

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I'll dream for a moment. So please stay by my side.
(When Odin nods, Nii closes her eyes and falls asleep. Even when she falls asleep, Nii's hand is still holding onto Odin's hand.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: %s. Come here.
(Odin gestures for %s to approach.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Take this. As the vision of Sinmara said, just hold it in your hand and enter Muspelheim.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel a mysterious power from the scales of the black dragon...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Odin, is Nii okay?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: If you sleep for a few hours and wake up, you'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Odin, does that dragon have a lot of trust in you?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I think Surtur’s treatment of you is no different.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: I see… ?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Anyway, Odin… . Let's hope this guy succeeds. Let's go, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, let's go.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Best wishes, %s… . When you come back, don't go here, go to where Ellie was.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, Odin. Then please take good care of Nii.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: If Hel believes in it, the conversation with Surtur will work out somehow... .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: The Muspels Tunnel door is over there. Can you see it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: But have you been speaking informally since a while ago?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did I speak informally? Oh, that's right. You also spoke informally, so I felt like I had to do that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry about that. Let's go first. It's important for me to enter Muspelheim now.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: I feel like something happened to me... . %s, come together. It will be less hot if you hold my hand and go in. hey!! Let’s go together!!

steps.name: The flow of fate is getting closer
steps.objective: Defeat [Surt] in “Muspels Tunnel” and obtain <Surtur’s Token>.  Then return to “Bigrid 4” and report the quest to [Ellie].

lines.text: (As they stand in front of the door they arrived at after comforting the grumbling Shinmara, the closed door opens. Hot heat flows out through the open door, grabs them, and pulls them in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it's hot.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: It's a shame... . Since I have black dragon scales, I should be able to endure it.
(When the heat disappears and you look ahead, you see an endless road leading somewhere. You can also see hot lava flowing somewhere below.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The lava is flowing like a river... .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: We call it the River of Fire as it appears. This river is the force that shapes our world, but to other worlds, it is a threat of death itself.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: So we built a tunnel above and covered it to manage this river. Then, the river is cooled down, purified into pure water, and then discharged outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you do that?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: The lava flowing in Muspelheim is bound to cover the land where the World Tree is located. So, if it flows like an ordinary river, there will be no problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you've cooled down the excitement of the lecture, can't you make it stop? Then this won't flow to the non-grid.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: … … Wait, what did you just say? Are you sure you said you wanted to stop the river?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Ah, Surtr… . Surt?! no!!
(The illusion of Shinmara moves around with an urgent expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing that?
(At that time, %s sees a woman approaching from a distance with a large sword drawn.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that person Surtr?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Stop, Surtr!!
(The illusion of Shinmara came forward to prevent what was about to happen, but the flame that exploded from the tip of the flaming sword had already flown toward Adventurer.)
Ku-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwak!
(Adventurer, which was unable to avoid the attack, flies straight up to the wall.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, uh… .
(The tip of a sharp sword, filled with a mixture of cold and heat, approaches Adventurer's neck.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Lift your head up. Traveler of another world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… .
(From the short dark red outfit to the dark red horns on her head, a woman who looks as if she is a burning flame is standing expressionless.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I am Surtr, the master of Muspelheim. say your name
(Surt closes his eyes upon hearing %s's name.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtur, put away your sword. That's because I didn't know that this person was talking about stopping the river of fire.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Damn it, shh.
(Surtur pretends to tell the illusion of Shinmara to be quiet.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: %s, you didn't lie about your name, did you?

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: (Surt?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My name is exactly what I told you.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Yes, %s.  Once again, as the owner of Muspelheim, I ask you this question. Do you really not know what it means for the river of fire flowing down here to stop?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I really don't know and I want to know. Why do you react like that... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: It's not a lie.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I'll tell you. Stopping the river of fire means killing me, the master of this world... .
(Just when you think Surtur's sword has been removed from %s's neck, a large flame awakens in his other hand and begins to dance.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: But that doesn’t excuse ignorance, %s… .
(The flame blooming from Surtur’s hand penetrates into %s’s chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, hot, hot!! Argh!!

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surt… . Ha, don't do it. Well, you can't do that... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Sinmara, I just do what I can. For the future of Muspelheim... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Su, surt… . What have you done to me?
(Looks at Adventurer, who is barely holding on to keep Surtur from falling.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: It didn't turn to ash because it had black dragon scales. It's holding up well.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: You don't have time. When the time comes, the spark that has permeated within you will explode like a firecracker.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this to me?
(When Surtur turns his back instead of answering, the illusion of Shinmara follows with an embarrassed expression.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: At the end of this tunnel, there is a passage leading to Muspelheim city center. I will be waiting in front of you.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Along the way, you will have to deal with all sorts of illusions created by Shinmara, from beings from other worlds who perceive you as enemies.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: And when you meet me, defeat me with your will.
(As soon as Surtur finishes speaking, he jumps into the river of fire flowing below and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's gone... .

lines.speaker: %s
