lines.text: Huh, it was something I was prepared for, but I never thought it would end up like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But, I feel strange... I feel like I have cold and heat inside me at the same time...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s not think too much and just go… . I have no choice but to go and talk properly.
(In the endless Muspels Tunnel, all threatening beings fall and disappear in the hands of Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if Shinmara's illusion is like that, the rest don't seem to exist in Muspelheim.
(Plus, with each step you take, the heat inside the Muspels Tunnel becomes a little stronger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems to be getting hotter...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Shinmara's words are true, the heat in the river should gradually cool down... … .
(%s, who was walking forward while looking around, sees a large door that looks like the end of a tunnel in front of him.)
(As you approach forward, the door opens and Surtr appears inside. As soon as Surt meets %s's eyes, he swings his sword sharply.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Surtr, I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: There is no time. Do it after you defeat me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like the Muspels Tunnel is getting hotter!
(At %s’s words, Surtur’s movement to continue his next attack stops.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has the tunnel stopped functioning?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: That's not it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If not, then what is? If you say that the river of fire that makes up Muspelheim is Surt, you yourself... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… , no way… .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The fire inside me is getting hotter.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The moment I woke up in the dark and opened my eyes, I was given a mission.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The owner of the world connected to the World Tree must fulfill his mission... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I cannot fulfill the mission of light and hope like the masters of other worlds.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: My mission is… .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Making all the beings of the world melt with the fire of Muspelheim, which I love.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: So, for a long time, I struggled not to keep my mission and not follow my destiny... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I guess today is the day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Surtr, wait a minute… .
(The moment Surtur swings his sword downward, everything around him, including Surtur's red eyes, burns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's so hot. If it continues like this, conversation will be impossible...)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Traveler from another world.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: If you want to confirm your fate, first struggle under the flames awakened in Muspelheim... .
(After Surtur finished speaking, the lava that was churning under the tunnel erupted and surged like a strong wave.)
(The two people's movements stop only after the lava, which was like a strong wave, crashed in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This time, I have to stop it properly...)
(Once again, the two's attacks collide, causing a large explosion. The impact causes Adventurer to fly far away and fall to the ground.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: %s, just as you move for your world, so do I for my world... .
(The moment Surt slowly approaches %s, the Muspels Tunnel begins to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm dizzy... .
(A situation that causes severe dizziness and cannot see anything. I reach out to grab something, but there seems to be nothing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm dizzy... … … . Tea, cold… , hot… . Ugh, uh… .
Plop… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Ah, I think I'll survive... I don't feel dizzy anymore...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The cold has disappeared, the hot has also disappeared…. It’s warm….)
%s, wake up. Wake up, wake up!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Shin Mara? I think this is Sin Mara’s voice….)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 목소리
lines.text: How long are you going to lie on Surt’s lap?!
(As the darkness surrounding %s dissipates, the rough appearance of the tunnel gradually comes into view. Moreover, there is even a river of fire flowing below...)
(And then his eyes meet the illusions of Surtur and Shinmara looking at him.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I came to my senses.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Surt? Ugh, ugh, sin. sorry.
(When Adventurer takes a step back in surprise, Surtur brushes the lava off his clothes as if nothing had happened and stands up.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: There's nothing to be sorry about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'm sorry. But Surtr… . Where we are now... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: In the middle of the road where the river of fire flows.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: A few hours ago, even Muspelheim was shaken as the new world was blocked from connecting with Vigrid.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: So, exhausted, you lost consciousness and fell into the path of the river of fire.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtur was startled and rescued you from falling into the river of fire.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Even if it had black dragon scales, no life could withstand this heat. Normally it would have melted and flowed down... . you… .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Even after falling into that place, he is alive and well.
(Adventurer is looking around. He is standing with Surtur in the shallows of the River of Fire.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ho, is it because of the flame that Surt planted in my heart?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: That flame would naturally disappear when you defeated me. Then, Sinmara will become the owner of Muspelheim on my behalf... .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtur, don’t say things like that! That's not what I wanted.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Sorry, sorry... .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: That's it. Anyway, it didn't happen.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: We got lucky... .
(Surtur squats down and quietly puts his hand into the river of fire.)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The moment the traveler from another world fell into the river of fire, the river's heat cooled. The heat inside me disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: At this rate, we will be able to send purified water to other worlds.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did this happen? I can’t believe the excitement of the lecture has cooled down… .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: There have been many blessings for you beyond time and space.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: The guardian of the world tree, the scales of a black dragon that preys, the purple fog that repels the energy of death, the energy of the flowering land, and even the will of a girl who dreams of happiness... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: %s, who are you? Who is this that is loved so much?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm an ordinary Adventurer. There's nothing else. It just happened because I was doing my job.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Okay, I got it.
(Surtur, who was blankly watching the river of fire flow, stands up and stretches out his hand. Then, the illusion of Shinmara, who had been hovering around him, approaches and sits down.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtur, is it over now?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: For now, it's over. The flow of my destiny has stopped for a moment, but it is over. And %s… .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: As you fell into the river of fire, a memory flowed into your mind... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me, Surtr.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Is the name of the world you came from Etoire?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Contrary to the will of its owner, the star is calling to another world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is clearly a memory of dangerous content, but strangely, I feel a sense of relief... It's not because Iris is weak or I did something wrong...)

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: … sorry. It's an inaccurate, fleeting memory... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Then go back and give this to Odin.
(Surt takes something out of his pocket and hands it to %s. It is a small badge with a rough drawing of Surtur's expressionless face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Surtr. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: I hope we never meet again. It's definitely not going to be a good thing.

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: %s, goodbye. Thank you. That's the way out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, there you are. Then I'll go.
(The illusion of Shinmara waves at the back of %s as he leaves, and Surtur looks at him intently.)

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: Surtr, let’s go back and rest. You haven't been able to relax even for a single day... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 신마라의 환영
lines.text: What's wrong? Surt? Are you in a bad mood?

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: No, it's not that it's bad, it just feels strange... .

lines.speaker: 수르트
lines.text: Even Shinma knows. Clearly, the world of Ymir was a long time ago... … … … .

steps.name: distant fate
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Eli] in 「Bigrid 4」, and meet [Odin] and [Nii] in [Bigrid 6]. 
2. Return to “Bigrid 4” and report the quest to [Ellie].

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Ha, ha... .
(The beings from another world, whose sole purpose was to eliminate Lerad, are cut down by Eli's sword.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: There are too many… . uh?
(The enemies that had been harassing Ellie stop moving. Then, they disappear like smoke before Eli's eyes and disperse into the sky.)
(As Ellie quietly looks at the sky, she discovers a rainbow hanging somewhere in the distant sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, I'm here.
(Ellie's eyes turn red at the sight of %s, who seems to be coming on a rainbow.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's over... .
(The above-mentioned Ellie slowly approaches %s and opens her arms and gently hugs her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh, Ellie?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Thanks to you, the ominous fog of death and the fiery intensity of fire no longer approach. So Bigrid got warmer.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: When was the last time you felt this kind of warmth?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I don't remember very well, but Elias was like that time when everyone was happy, and Luminous was like that when the kids laughed normally... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elias…?)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Oh, sorry… .
(Ellie laughs and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I liked it so much that I couldn’t stop… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Have you ever wanted to give something to Odin? Wait, do you want to show me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here.
(As soon as Ellie sees the badge with Surtur's stern expression on it, she bursts into laughter.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Puhahaha, hahahaha!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Hahahaha, this is so funny... . Haha, haha. Fuhahahaha.
(After laughing for a while, Ellie wipes the tears from her eyes and takes a deep breath.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Haha… . It's really fun. Who would have thought that the owner of Muspelheim would prove himself like this.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Even though it looks like that, it must have tremendous power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay. It's because I'm relaxed... . Phew… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Shall we go now? Odin and Nii will be waiting.
(The blue leaves of Lerad move as if dancing in the blowing wind. And below, Odin and Nii are holding hands and looking at the rainbow hanging in the sky.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin... .
(Odin and Nii smile as they spot Ellie and Adventurer approaching towards Lerrad.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work, everyone... . And I'm sorry... . This is all my fault... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Odin. Something bad just happened... .

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin, that's right. Something bad happened. Think so. As long as we live, only good things can't always happen.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: So we can overcome it quickly.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes, Odin. Please believe so. Since I have believed that until now, I will continue to believe so.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I heard Ellie always says the right things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice work too Nii. Thanks to this, I was able to enter the Muspels Tunnel safely.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Thank goodness. I was a little worried because I wasn't the same as before.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: In the past, it was active enough to destroy the world.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin! too bad!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: It's true... . Ah, Nii! Don't hit me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, Odin… . Here's something Surtr told me to tell you.
(Only after Odin holds the tokens of Hel and Surtr in his hands does a light smile appear on his stiff face.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: With this, nothing will happen in Bigrid for the time being. Niflheim and Muspelheim will both be fine.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: And Ouroboros doesn't seem to be moving either... .

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay? Odin... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: %s, I think your work is done. Everything that needs to be done here... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As the main lord of this world, I have found a way to ensure that your time and space remain intact.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: %s, you found it yourself. I was only helping... .

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Ellie.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin, please speak. Uh, this is… .
(Nii hands the blue glowing leaves of Lherad to Ellie.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: What are you doing, Ellie? Get it quickly. Before it withers… .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Let's call that being.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Ah… , there was a way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That being?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: That existence will help you go to the front of the standard of time and space. Bye then, %s… .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: No time, %s. Because the rainbow that illuminates this place does not last forever.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: If you meet that being, you'll be able to see us later. So hurry up now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Odin, Nii. Thank you. And I'm fine... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Odin, Nii. See you later too.
(Eli greets Odin and Nii and exits the way he came.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I never thought we would meet so soon... . That means that both our time and the world's time are running out... .

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii… ?
(Nii raises her index finger to Odin's lips and laughs playfully.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin, you have too many worries.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: We just need to spend the time to come as well as the time we have spent in the future. Because that's what you and I live for.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Okay, Nii.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: When Ellie finishes work, we can go back. To Luminous, the city of light we love... .

steps.name: Between hidden times
steps.objective: After speaking with [Ellie] in “Bigrid 4,” complete the quest immediately.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, wait here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no one there, so who are you meeting?
(Ellie smiles as she looks at the puzzled Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'll call you right away. take my hand

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.
(Ellie inserts the leaf of Latrad between her own hand and the hand of Adventurer. As the two slowly walk forward, the surroundings begin to gradually darken.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Lerad's leaves led us to the man.
(When Ellie's steps stop, %s who was following behind also stops. As she quietly looks ahead, the figure of someone who had been invisible in the darkness slowly begins to emerge.)
(A mysterious woman wearing a robe greets Ellie in a low voice as she looks at her.)
Ellie, welcome.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It’s been a while, Lili.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: I didn't know it would come with Adventurer... . Seeing that you came together, it seems like the time has finally come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lili?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, Lili is helping Etoire and Luminous behind the scenes.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: Ellie, as I said before, I am not Riri. I just borrowed his appearance... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: But then again, it's Lily. Doing Riri’s work in the form of Riri… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I call you?

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: If you really want to call me a wizard, call me a wizard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, wizard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wizard… . wizard?!

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: %s, I wanted to say thank you for meeting you. I always feel sorry for you... .

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: Protecting Iris and protecting Bigrid... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lili, no, wizard. I think I've seen you before.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: That's right. I know you. Maybe you saw it.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: Even before I came to Belos… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Lili, we don't have time.

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: I know. However, if you use this method, it will also affect Ellie. Do Odin and Nii know this?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's okay. Because it's something I've decided to do anyway... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Riri will stop your time in Vigrid now. You, who will wake up from the front rather than the other side, must find and solve what needs to be done in the front time.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Just as Vigrid blocked the gates of Niflheim and cooled the heat of the river flowing through Muspelheim... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What can I do?

lines.speaker: 리리
lines.text: You just need to stay still with your eyes closed. Then, you will return to the time before time and space were divided centered around you in Etoire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, wizard… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Ellie.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Hurry and close your eyes... , %s.
(As Adventurer quietly closes his eyes, even the voice of Ellie who was talking to him becomes a little blurry.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, can you do me a favor? There is someone I would like to say hello to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I will.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: To my beloved kingdom Elias and to my younger brother whom I love just as much... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, where is your brother? But my kingdom?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: My soul still remembers without forgetting... . And my kingdom... .
(At that moment, the feeling of Ellie moving away approaches and her voice can no longer be heard. Like that, Adventurer falls into a deep sleep.)
